description.en:
Midas Fasanara Global Open (mGLO) is a tokenized exposure to Fasanara's
Global Open strategy, issued by Midas on Base. mGLO is an ERC-20
yield-bearing token: holders receive the strategy's performance directly
through the token price (NAV), with no rebases and no separate reward
claim. Mint and redeem are permissioned and routed through Midas's
DepositVault and RedemptionVault contracts. The NAV is published on-chain
by the Midas Oracle Admin and consumed by every vault interaction. Fasanara is the
underlying asset manager.
